rules.title: How the ranking is computed
rules.eligibility: Eligible: the players of Crociata Nera, Crociata Rossa and Crociata d'Oro with the highest town hall of the three clans and those one level below, not excluded. The others stay at the bottom of the ranking.
rules.cwl: Last CWL, fought in Crociata Nera, Rossa or d'Oro (up to 25 points): commendations up to 12 (Certezza di Lega 5, Guerriero di Lega 3, Campione di Lega 5, Leggenda della Lega 7) and stars per attack and destruction up to 13; with fewer than 3 attacks the performance is reduced in proportion.
rules.war: Regular wars of the last 90 days, in every clan of the Crusade (up to 40 points): stars per attack and destruction (75%) and attacks used (25%); with fewer than 8 attacks the score is reduced in proportion.
rules.order: On equal scores the higher town hall goes first, then whoever is in a higher league, then the higher role (leader, co-leader, elder, member). The first {{starters}} eligible players are the starters (blue), the next {{reserves}} are the reserves (green).
rules.heroes: Heroes (up to 20 points): hero levels (two thirds) and equipment worn (one third) against the highest levels of the game; a hero not unlocked yet counts zero. Each player's profile is read again about every 6 hours.
rules.townHall: Town hall: 10 points to those with the highest town hall of the three clans.
rules.league: League (up to 5 points): 1 point in Electro League 31, 2 in Electro 32, 3 in Electro 33, 4 in Legend III, 5 in Legend II and I; no points in the lower leagues.
rules.penalties: Penalties: 3 points for each attack missed in the last CWL (at most 15); 5 points for recruits (member role) who joined the clans of the Crusade less than 14 days ago: elders, co-leaders and leaders coming back are not penalised.
rules.exclusions: Administrators and the leader of Crociata Nera can exclude a player (for example for an announced absence): they keep their place in the ranking, marked as excluded, and their slot in the team goes to the next one. An exclusion lasts for the current season only, unless it is "until revoked".
rules.noCwl: Who was not in the line-up of the last CWL keeps its 25 points: they move to the regular wars, worth up to 65. So 100 can be reached without the CWL too.

chats.title: Channels
chats.intro: Choose what each channel receives: the announcements (one channel only) or the bases of a town hall. Every base lives in one channel only, the one of its town hall: if you change the town hall of a channel, its bases move to the channel of their town hall (or wait until there is one) and the bases of the new town hall arrive. The announcements channel never receives bases: to give it a town hall, set it back to “None” first. Lock the channels so they are not changed by mistake. A channel appears here when you add the bot as an administrator; if it already is one, post a message in the channel or add it below.
